messages:
Maria L: Heads-up — I'm taking over primary for the evening. quick state: no active P0s but pager volume for latency p99 is sticky since earlier. I left a short checklist below.

Ajay P: thanks — do you know which region is spiking?

Maria L: us-west-2 mostly. traces show more queuing on model-shard-3 pools.

IncidentBot: Pager escalated to P1: high inference latency (p99 > 1200ms) — affected customers: 3. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-421

Tess (SRE): pinging blake for capacity questions. Blake, can we spin a temp burst pool or do a graceful fallback to the smaller quantized model?

Blake: can do fallback, but need primary signoff. fallback route configured at /config/routing/fallbacks -> production:quantized-v1. Quick command to flip (non-destructive): 
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/routing/fallbacks/production -d '{"active": "quantized-v1"}'
```
Use canary first (set canary=true) then monitor.

Samir: if we flip, watch token cost delta and similarity metrics. Set a short eval against our sentinel prompts (/runbooks/sentinels).

Maria L: good call. I'm going to open a canary window 10% traffic to quantized-v1 now.

Ajay P: while that's running — if latency stays high, we should also try a soft restart of the shard workers on model-shard-3. Common safe command: 
```text
/ops restart workers --pool model-shard-3 --grace 45s
```
Do that only after announcing on #eng-oncall.

Maria L: starting canary now (10%). watchlist: p99, client-errors, and similarity-score. Link to runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback-and-quantized-checks

IncidentBot: Canary set: production -> quantized-v1 (10%). Monitoring enabled.

Tess (SRE): quick triage pointers I'm pasting: 
- If p99 falls <700ms after canary -> keep and gradually ramp to 50% then 100%.
- If error-rate increases >0.5% -> rollback immediately and call for hotfix.
- If canary looks fine but p99 persists, schedule restart of shard with stagger (30s apart) and drain connections first.
- Commands & dashboards: /dash/p99-latency, /dash/error-rate, /ops/kvcache/flush (only if you see stale prefixes)

Samir: note on KV: flushing is usually last resort — it degrades cache-hit rates briefly. Command: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/kvcache/flush?pool=model-shard-3` (requires ops token).

Blake: I'm standing by to spin a burst pool if the canary fails. ETA to add two gpus to model-shard-3 pool ~8m.

Maria L: canary looks stable for first 3 min, p99 dropped from 1250 -> 680. continuing 10 min watch. I'm leaving the runbook link pinned in thread.

Ajay P: FYI — I've updated the oncall doc with handoff notes for next shift: primary -> Maria L, secondary -> Tess (SRE). coverage gap: APAC night window. Link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/handovers/2026-03-15-evening

Tess (SRE): noted. if anything degrades during my secondary window, escalate to Blake for capacity or Samir for model-eval.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-421 status: monitoring, assigned -> Maria L, priority P1.

Maria L: final quick checklist I'm leaving for the swap: 
- open console: /ops/console -> check gpus-util > 90%? -> call Blake.
- run `curl` fallback canary (see above) if p99>1000ms
- if errors spike, rollback canary and run `ops restart workers` on affected shard
- only flush KV if you confirm stale-prefix indicators on /dash/kv-hitrate
- notify #support about potential customer impact (template below)

Maria L: support template: "We’re investigating elevated latency impacting inference. Temporary mitigation applied (traffic routing to quantized-v1 canary). We’ll update within 30 minutes with next steps. Contact eng-oncall for technical updates."

Blake: thumbs-up on the flow. Leaving my contact for escalation: @blake (pager).

Samir: I'll draft a quick post-incident eval task for regression checks against the sentinel prompts once we finish.

Maria L: thanks team — handing off primary to Tess at 00:30 UTC. leaving the pinned links and commands in the runbook. any last asks?

Tess (SRE): all good, taking over at 00:30 UTC. thanks Maria for the handover notes. :thumbsup:
